title: The Package That Stayed at Home
fact_notes: 登場人物・具体的な出来事は架空の教材例。実在の調査・統計を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Two schools in different countries decided to introduce everyday life through an exchange of small packages.
sentences.ja: 異なる国の二つの学校が小さな荷物を交換し日常生活を紹介することにした。

sentences.en: The students planned to collect objects representing their community and write a short explanation for each.
sentences.ja: 地域を表す物を集め、それぞれに短い説明を書く計画だった。

sentences.en: One group prepared a package that included a handmade model, traditional decorations, and a local food product.
sentences.ja: 一方のグループは手作りの模型、伝統的な飾り、地元の食品を含む荷物を用意した。

sentences.en: They were excited to imagine how their overseas friends would react to the familiar objects.
sentences.ja: 海外の友人が身近な物にどう反応するか想像してわくわくした。

sentences.en: Before sending the package, their teacher invited the students to check the partner school's requirements.
sentences.ja: 発送前、教師は交流校の条件を確認するよう生徒に求めた。

sentences.en: The partner teacher explained that the classroom had limited space for storing physical materials.
sentences.ja: 相手の教師は実物の資料を保管する教室の場所が限られていると説明した。

sentences.en: She also asked them to avoid sending food until the relevant rules and possible concerns were checked.
sentences.ja: 関連ルールと懸念事項が確認されるまで食品を送らないよう求めた。

sentences.en: The students realized that sharing their culture involved considering the situation of the people receiving it.
sentences.ja: 文化を紹介するには受け取る側の状況も考慮する必要があると気づいた。

sentences.en: Rather than abandoning the exchange, the group discussed how to introduce the food without shipping it.
sentences.ja: 交流を諦めず、食品を送らずに紹介する方法を話し合った。

sentences.en: They recorded a short video showing how the product was displayed in a local shop.
sentences.ja: 地元の店で商品がどのように並べられているか短い動画に収めた。

sentences.en: A family member explained when people might enjoy the food and why it was meaningful to her.
sentences.ja: 家族の一人がいつその食品を楽しむことがあるか、なぜ自分にとって意味があるか説明した。

sentences.en: The students added subtitles in English and invited the partner class to ask questions about the video.
sentences.ja: 英語字幕を付け、相手のクラスに動画について質問するよう促した。

sentences.en: In return, the overseas students introduced a similar food that was popular in their own neighborhood.
sentences.ja: お返しに海外の生徒は自分たちの近所で人気の似た食品を紹介した。

sentences.en: The classes compared the occasions on which people enjoyed the two foods and noticed unexpected similarities.
sentences.ja: 両クラスは二つの食品が楽しまれる場面を比較し、意外な共通点に気づいた。

sentences.en: They also discussed how individual family traditions could differ even within the same local community.
sentences.ja: 同じ地域の中でも各家庭の習慣は異なり得ることも話し合った。

sentences.en: Their exchange became a conversation about experiences rather than a competition to represent an entire nation.
sentences.ja: 交流は国全体を代表する競争ではなく体験についての対話になった。

sentences.en: Eventually, the schools exchanged a smaller selection of objects together with several digital presentations.
sentences.ja: 最終的に両校は少数の品といくつかのデジタル発表を交換した。

sentences.en: The students discovered that some aspects of culture could be communicated effectively without sending physical objects.
sentences.ja: 文化の一部は実物を送らなくても効果的に伝えられると分かった。

sentences.en: They also understood that a single object or personal story could not represent everyone in a country.
sentences.ja: 一つの物や個人的な話で国の全員を代表することはできないとも理解した。

sentences.en: The package that stayed at home nevertheless helped open a new conversation across national borders.
sentences.ja: 送らず家に残した包みも国境を越えた新しい対話を開く助けとなった。

vocabulary.definition: the act of sharing things or ideas
things used to make something attractive
as a response to what was received
relating to one person or unit
in a way producing the desired result

questions.prompt: What did the schools plan to exchange?
questions.explanation_ja: 日常生活を紹介する小荷物。

questions.prompt: What was included in one planned package?
questions.explanation_ja: 地元の食品が入っていた。

questions.prompt: What problem did the partner teacher mention?
questions.explanation_ja: 保管場所が限られていた。

options: The schools had ended all contact.
Rules and possible concerns needed to be checked.
Food was never part of the plan.
questions.explanation_ja: 関連ルールや懸念を確認する必要があった。

questions.prompt: What did the group make instead?
options: A short video about the food.
questions.explanation_ja: 食品を紹介する短い動画。

questions.prompt: What did they add to the video?
What did the overseas students introduce?
options: A similar food from their neighborhood.

questions.prompt: What did discussing family traditions help students recognize?
options: Every family has the same habits.
A single person represents a whole nation.
Objects explain every aspect of culture.
Practices can vary within one community.
questions.explanation_ja: 一つの地域でも家庭ごとに異なる。

options: In a way that works well.
Only physical objects can communicate culture.
Cultural exchange can adapt to recipients' needs and use diverse ways of sharing.
One story fully represents a country.
questions.explanation_ja: 相手の状況に応じ多様な方法で文化を共有する。

grammar.explanation_ja: 現在分詞がobjectsを修飾する。

grammar.explanation_ja: untilは〜するまで、were checkedは受動態。
rather thanは代替行動を示す。

grammar.focus: could not represent everyone in a country
grammar.explanation_ja: could notは不可能性を示す。

paraphrases.source: The students planned to collect objects representing their community and write a short explanation for each.
paraphrases.rewrite: They intended to gather items that showed features of their community and describe them briefly.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 地域を表す物を集め説明する計画。

paraphrases.source: She also asked them to avoid sending food until the relevant rules and possible concerns were checked.
paraphrases.rewrite: She requested that they wait to send food until they had examined the applicable rules and concerns.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 確認まで食品発送を待つよう求めた。

paraphrases.source: Rather than abandoning the exchange, the group discussed how to introduce the food without shipping it.
paraphrases.rewrite: The group looked for a way to present the food without mailing it instead of giving up the exchange.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 交流を諦めず食品を送らない方法を探した。

paraphrases.source: They also understood that a single object or personal story could not represent everyone in a country.
paraphrases.rewrite: They understood that no single object or personal account could speak for an entire country.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 一つの話で国全体を代表できない。
